verdict.rationale: Square has a dedicated official docs page on Idempotency explaining the pattern for safe retries, and the SDK shows a idempotency_key-like usage pattern in payment creation calls (client.payments.create with sourceId, version override) consistent with idempotent request design. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of retry behavior avoiding duplicate charges, and more detail on idempotency key scope/TTL beyond the docs title.
